افتقدتن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَقَدْتُنَّ (iftaqadtunna) /if.ta.qad.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# اُفْتُقِدْتُنَّ (uftuqidtunna) /uf.tu.qid.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
